audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike text credits her ult with 'extra dogs, movement speed and a heal' — her R is a 900-range pack dash with a shielded recast; the dogs/MS come from W and the heal from E.

audit.corrected: Spike and why texts now describe the real R.

audit.whatIsWrong: TLDR called her R a 'point-and-click root'; 'Darkin Dagger dash' misattributes the dash (Eviscerate is the dash, Q is the bleed daggers); Ryze credited with a shield/passive shield he does not have; her W untargetability (26s CD) never mentioned; no cooldown digits anywhere; she is misgendered in 18 fields.
audit.corrected: R described as pack dash with shielded recast; Eviscerate named as the dash; shield claims removed; W untargetability and real cooldowns added; pronouns fixed.

audit.why: report[8] already calls for early anti-heal into her sustain (E fully heals packmates) — matches the needs-antiheal missing interaction.

edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rune Prison has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Hounds' Pursuit: 110/95/80s — the lock-on pack dash that starts her dive; stand near minions to body-block the hounds. - The Call of the Pack (26s at rank 1) makes her untargetable — never dump Q-E-Q into it, wait it out. - Your W Rune Prison has one job: the moment her commit arrives.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are her strongest stretch — she can all-in with packmate damage and dash resets, and at 6 her ult adds dogs, speed and a heal that makes every gap-close lethal to a solo Ryze. Your Realm Warp does nothing to save the 1v1, so play for XP under tower, ward for the dive, and only fight when your jungler is present.

notes: Chart: full rows 1-4 moved to agree with content win[] and packet (which already matched); win[N] untouched per chart rule. Fixed the suspectName by removing 'Darkin Dagger dash' entirely — the dash in her all-in is Eviscerate (E); Q is the bleed daggers (its 'dash' derived flag reflects packmates leaping, not Naafiri dashing — noted as a probable flag misfire). Her R per kit text is dash + shielded recast + reveal, not dogs/MS/heal — all such claims rewritten. Removed Ryze 'passive shield' claims. Report edits beyond two rewrites are lint-mandated pronoun swaps only (substantive changes confined to report[0] and report[7]). W root does not stop a dash already in flight — advice phrased as canceling the all-in before/after the dash, not mid-dash.
